newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline gains on crude contango, tight Med.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline gains on crude contango, tight Med.

text.p: NWE gasoline gained about $1-$2 a tonne on Friday with support derived from crude's continued contango and tightness in the Med.
Traders said there was discussion on taking NWE material into the Med although nothing was thought done so far.
"I'm hearing that the arb is workable, but I'm cautious myself...there are too many people bring barrels into the U.K," said one trader.
A Med 20-25,000 tonne cargo was heard sold at fob high quotes +$2-3 for mid-June.
The short term prospects for gasoline were starting to improve with NWE material possibly heading transatlantic.

There was a rumour in the market of a cargo being sold into the U.S, but the company cited said they did not even have a cargo available. Another later date cargo, however, was expected to make the trip to the U.S although no deal was heard concluded.
